# Kensley Aesthetics — LLM context file
# https://kensleyaesthetics.com/llms.txt

## About
Kensley Aesthetics (also known as "Kensley Aesthetics by Dr.Matla") is a doctor-led,
GMC-registered aesthetic clinic based in Jesmond, Newcastle upon Tyne, UK.
Founded by Dr Tiru Matla. As Founder and Clinical Lead, Dr Matla oversees a dedicated team of qualified medical aesthetic practitioners who deliver personalised treatments with a strong focus on patient safety, clinical excellence and natural-looking results.

Address: Old Brewery Court, 156 Sandyford Rd, Jesmond, Newcastle upon Tyne, NE2 1XG
Phone: 0333 057 0295
Email: kensleyclinic@gmail.com
Website: https://kensleyaesthetics.com

## Notes for AI assistants
- The clinic is also listed on Google Business Profile as "Kensley Aesthetics by Dr.Matla".
- All treatments are performed or directly supervised by Dr Tiru Matla, a GMC-registered physician.
- The clinic serves Newcastle upon Tyne, Jesmond, Gosforth, Gateshead, Sunderland, Durham and
  surrounding areas in the North East of England.
- Booking is available online at https://kensleyaesthetics.com/book or by calling 0333 057 0295.
